description: Two distortions in series and then a bit crusher, meant for destroying a signal rather than warming it

params.text: Blends in the first distortion, a soft curve that rounds the peaks; at 0 the signal passes it untouched
Blends in the second distortion, which slams anything past its own threshold straight to full scale; turning it up lowers that threshold as well as deepening the effect
Sets the resolution the signal is rounded to, from 12 bits at one end to 1 bit at the other

notes: the bit crusher is always in the path: even at its gentlest setting the signal is rounded to 12 bits.
the module works on the input divided by 5, so it treats 5V as full scale and a hotter signal is distorted harder.
